mapper.sql: verification_id AS verificationId, action_run_id AS actionRunId, instance_id AS instanceId, result, evidence_json AS evidenceJson, failure_reason AS failureReason, verified_by AS verifiedBy, verified_time AS verifiedTime, create_time AS createTime
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_workflow_verification (verification_id, action_run_id, instance_id, result, evidence_json, failure_reason, verified_by, verified_time, create_time) VALUES (#{row.verificationId}, #{row.actionRunId}, #{row.instanceId}, #{row.result}, #{row.evidenceJson}, #{row.failureReason}, #{row.verifiedBy}, #{row.verifiedTime}, #{row.createTime})
mapper.select: SELECT FROM t_workflow_verification WHERE instance_id = #{instanceId} ORDER BY verified_time, verification_id
